address: 1155 Argyle Street, Finnieston, Glasgow City, G3 8TB, United Kingdom
bio: Nestled within the trendy Finnieston neighbourhood, this friendly bistro comes from the team behind The Gannet, which previously occupied this site. The tantalising à la carte opens with snacks (look out for oysters served multiple ways) and lightly glazed milk bread with whipped butter, before moving onto more substantial dishes such as a generous helping of Barra cockles with Café de Paris butter. Be sure to check out the chalked-up specials too, and start your visit at the bar with a martini, Manhattan or, as you’re in Scotland, a Rob Roy.
